name: Dinner Burrito
steps: Cook the ground beef in a skillet until fully browned. Drain any excess fat and season with salt, pepper, and your choice of spices (such as cumin, chili powder, or paprika).
Cook the rice with a 2:3 ratio of rice to water, and let it simmer until the water is absorbed (maybe 8 minutes or so). Add the black beans to the rice and mix well.
Layer the cooked beef, rice, black beans, cheese, salsa, and avocado in each tortilla.
Fold the sides of the tortilla over the filling and roll it up.
